usedFor: WooCommerce holds customers, and Microsoft Excel gets a row per “New Customer Created” through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in WooCommerce, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new customer lands in an Excel table as a row.

watchOut: “Coupon Deleted” also reaches “Add Row To Table”, so a deletion adds a row rather than removing one.
